description.value:
Mei Terumi's signature ambient genjutsu. Each creature within 30 feet of you perceives the world plunged into total blackness — their own allies, their own hands, the sky all vanish.

Each affected creature attempts a Will save. On a failure, they treat all sight-based perception as if in total darkness for as long as they remain within the emanation and you continue to Sustain.

You and any creatures you designate at the time of casting are unaffected (your team can act normally; theirs cannot).

The illusion ends if the target takes damage from a source they cannot perceive (the very next Strike will often dispel it), or after 1 minute.
